notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.lakeland.co.uk/robots.txt) has no Anthropic/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User disallow and only blocks admin/cart/search/sort paths - full HTTP access permitted. Tier (a) direct HTTP (requests) used for robots.txt, sitemap.xml + sitemap_collections_1.xml (603 collection URLs), homepage HTML (mega-menu nav), and collection-page static HTML (category-banner subcategory strips, h1 confirmation). Tier (b) Playwright/Chromium (headless) used only where exact product counts were needed, since Lakeland's collection pages render an Algolia InstantSearch widget client-side (no product count present in raw HTML/SSR) - loaded each candidate URL, waited for hydration, and read the rendered 'N results found' stats text plus product-card titles for content verification. No blocks encountered at any tier; Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) was not needed. TREE METHOD: union of (1) 8 top-level mega-menu sections on the homepage (New In, Cooking & Dining, Baking, Cleaning, Laundry, Storage & Home, Electricals, Offers) read in full, (2) the 603-URL collections sitemap, and (3) each relevant collection page's own 'category-banners-wrapper' sibling/child strip. Lakeland is a kitchenware/houseware retailer (Shopify platform) with only a thin Textile/Storage footprint; most of the site is cookware, bakeware, appliances and cleaning products which are out of scope. QTY METHOD: Algolia-rendered 'X results found' text on each collection page after JS hydration; two pages (Tablecloths & Table Runners, Shower Basket & Shelves) rendered an explicit 'Sorry, we found no results' empty-state, recorded as qty=0. EXCLUDED and why: Heated Blankets/Heated Throws/Heated Pillows & Cushions (under Electricals > Heating & Cooling - primary product type is an electric heating appliance, not textile bedding, per PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE principle); Clothes Hangers (garment-hanging tool, not a storage container/organizer/basket/box per storage.md's own category lists); Dish Racks, Sink Storage, Washing Bags, Cling Film, Fridge & Freezer Bags, Food Preservers, Food Storage Clips/Ties/Labels, Lunch & Snack Boxes, Recycling Bins, Bin Liners, Place Mats & Coasters (verified single product = disposable paper coasters) - none are genuine storage/organization or textile home-furnishing products by primary purpose (drying racks, sink accessories, single-use consumables, sealing labels, portable carry bags, waste management, disposable paper goods); Garden Storage and Garden Tools & Storage (verified via rendered product titles - dominated by lawnmowers/strimmers/hedge trimmers/tap protectors, not genuine storage products, so both excluded wholesale); Serving Boards & Dishes, Tableware, Dining & Entertaining, Bowls, Glassware, Dinner Sets, Cutlery Sets, Mugs/Cups/Saucers (Kitchen & Dining, out of scope for both categories); all cooking/baking/cleaning-electrical hardware. Kitchen Textiles, Food Storage, Kitchen Storage & Organisation, Clothes & Shoe Storage, and Multipurpose Storage parent hub URLs were NOT recorded since each has valid recorded subcategories (parent-URL rule). Storage Boxes, Storage Baskets and Vacuum Storage Bags are cross-linked identically from both 'Clothes & Shoe Storage' and 'Multipurpose Storage' menus (same URLs) - each recorded once only, grouped under Clothes & Shoe Storage. Bathroom Storage, Vanity Storage, Shower Caddy, Shower Basket & Shelves, Sink Storage, Garden Storage and Garden Tools & Storage are not linked from the main mega-menu but are live, sitemap-listed, cross-linked collection pages (confirmed via h1 match) - included/excluded on their own merits per the union rule in STEP 2.2.
